question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.
sql:
-- Final query with years 0-19
WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, term_start AS initial_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0
      AND term_start >= '1917-01-01'
      AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
years AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(0, 19)) AS year_offset
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.initial_term_start,
        y.year_offset,
        -- The target date: Dec 31 of (initial_term_start year + year_offset years)
        (DATE_TRUNC('year', c.initial_term_start::DATE) + (y.year_offset || ' years')::INTERVAL + INTERVAL '11 months 30 days')::DATE AS check_date,
        -- Check if this legislator was in office on check_date
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
              AND lt.term_start::DATE <= (
                  (DATE_TRUNC('year', c.initial_term_start::DATE) + (y.year_offset || ' years')::INTERVAL + INTERVAL '11 months 30 days')::DATE
              )
              AND lt.term_end::DATE >= (
                  (DATE_TRUNC('year', c.initial_term_start::DATE) + (y.year_offset || ' years')::INTERVAL + INTERVAL '11 months 30 days')::DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
              )
        ) AS retained
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years y
)
SELECT 
    year_offset,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cohort,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_count,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN retained THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS retention_rate
FROM retention
GROUP BY year_offset
ORDER BY year_offset
